coop_context.advice: Co-op work terms and internships are direct student work experience — present them like jobs: employer, title, dates, and quantified bullets. If the posting is an internship, say 'co-op work term' or 'internship' explicitly so the equivalence is obvious.

bilingual_context.advice: If you work in more than one language, say so explicitly with your working level — it is an asset for many Canadian employers.

evidence_strength_rules: Course code/name only = weak evidence at most.
Club membership only = weak evidence at most.
Club leadership with concrete tasks, metrics, stakeholders, tools, or outcomes = strong evidence.
Work terms, internships, jobs, and concrete projects always outweigh course-only evidence.
source_notes: Fallback pack used when a student names a university we don't have a dedicated pack for. It keeps the tool useful for every commerce student without pretending to know their school.
